# EventWizz Customer Sites

EventWizz hosts white-label event booking sites for UK venues and promoters.

## Public pages

- `/` — venue home (locations list or single-location events)
- `/{location-slug}` — events in a city or venue
- `/{location-slug}/events/{event-slug}` — event detail and booking
- `/blog` — venue blog posts when enabled

## Contact

For platform support see https://eventwizz.com
